title: Analytics - Future Leaders Graduate Program
description:
Real ownership. Real impact. Build from day one. 

Are you an ambitious graduate ready to tackle complex , real-world challenges at the intersection of data, strategy and tech? 

The Future Leaders Graduate Program – Business Analytics at Picnic is a one-year launchpad for exceptional talents. From day one, you join a business team, own a business topic, and become an expert in your field.

At Picnic, we’re building the future of grocery. Using cutting-edge technology and data-driven innovation, we challenge the status quo and build the world’s smartest, most customer-focused supermarket. 
We move fast, think big, and turn bold ideas into tangible impact.

Tricks of the trade 

- Lead with ambition : Bring your relentless determination, creativity, and grit. Take the driver’s seat and redefine the grocery shopping experience for millions. You will be expected to think independently, move fast, and deliver results.

- Steep learning curve : Your growth comes from owning real problems, testing your ideas, learning from your mistakes and starting again. You'll blend hands-on training with immediate execution, you’ll move at a pace that accelerates your growth like nowhere else.

- Solve real-life puzzles : Spot opportunities, use tools at the forefront of technology, and own the outcome end to end. Not just making slides, but building the solution yourself.

- Innovate across borders : You’ll collaborate with teams across the Netherlands, Germany, and France, tackling challenges that redefine how Picnic operates at a European scale.

- High-performance environment : You’ll work alongside some of the best teams in analytics and tech, people who set a high bar and expect you to do the same.

From learning to leading 

Throughout this one-year program, you’ll own business-critical projects from start to finish right from the get-go, supported by mentorship, learning sessions, and regular feedback.

You’ll strengthen your leadership skills in project management, storytelling, stakeholder communication, and giving and receiving feedback, while sharpening your technical skills in Python, SQL, Excel, and PowerPoint.

As your scope grows, so does your responsibility. You might scale your initial project or take on new challenges within the same domain. Either way, there’s always a new challenge to lead and an opportunity to make an impact. That’s why every journey is unique: there’s no standardized path through the program, just continuous opportunities to grow and lead.

Where you’ll make an impact 

From day one, you’ll be embedded in a business team, taking ownership in one of the following domains:

- Consumer - Drive growth through pricing, supplier strategy, and our market strategy. Think: Shaping our successful market entry into new cities. Your decisions shape how millions of customers experience Picnic. 

- Logistics - Build the backbone of Picnics operations. Think: robotic fulfilment, demand forecasting, route optimization across Europe and much more

Your superpowers 

You don't wait for permission. You see a problem, build the solution, and bring people with you, before anyone asks. You've probably already started something: a project, a product, a business, an initiative that didn't exist until you made it happen.

More specifically, you:

- Are about to graduate (or recently graduated) a Masters in a quantitative field : e.g., mathematics, econometrics, engineering, or similar

- Have experience in high-performance environments: consulting, fast-growth startups, or competitive internships and know what it means to raise the bar

- Show an entrepreneurial mindset : you build, improve, and take ownership without being asked

- Think like a builder : hands-on, curious, and driven to challenge the status quo with practical solutions

- You have already gained basic knowledge in PowerPoint, Python, SQL, Excel or alternative coding languages 

- EU citizenship or valid EU working permit required .

Many strong candidates (particularly women) talk themselves out of applying because they don't tick every box. If this excites you and you believe you have what it takes, apply. We only hire when we find the right match. That’s why our selection process is intentionally highly selective. 

Why Picnic? 

- Grow as we grow . We’re scaling quickly across countries and millions of customers and this is just the start. Grow your impact as we grow; we invest in your path but the driver's seat is always yours

- Work with other innovators. Work with a driven, energetic team that builds, wins, and celebrates together (think of legendary Friday drinks, our Ski trip and our parties)

- Kickstart your career. Earn a competitive salary and step into a program designed to launch your long-term future at Picnic

When are you joining? 

- Fall Edition 2026
Start dates: September, October
*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question 

- Winter Edition 2026
Start dates: November, December
*earlier or later dates can be arranged, please indicate your preference in the application question 

📍 Location: Full-time in Hamburg, with periodic trips to NL or FR

There is no deadline : Our aim is to find the most ambitious people out there. We onboard talents on a monthly basis, so whether you join in April or August, you’ll always have a group of people sharing the ride. 

Picnic Perks 

🏆 Rewarding Impact from Day One 

You’ll receive an attractive compensation package, designed to reward your ambition, drive, and the direct impact you’ll make from your very first project.

🍎Learning & development 

Our Future Leaders Graduate Program - Business Analytics is designed to offer you a steep learning curve by taking business ownership and end-to-end responsibility early on. You’ll get to learn by doing, while mentored by our Picnic leaders that had a similar journey like you. Next to that, you’ll benefit from other opportunities like Lepaya training for polishing soft skills or Picnic Tech Academy training in case you want to learn new skills other than what you already do in this program. We also offer free access to trained psychologists via our OpenUp partner, and German language classes if you’d like to get your experience in Germany to the next level. 

🗺️Relocation 

If you’re moving from another country to join Picnic we make it as smooth as possible for you. We’ll cover your flight costs and a first month's accommodation. 

🥗Fresh Lunch, coffee, and snacks 

Our offices are equipped with fully-fledged coffee bars and a kitchen. We get delicious fresh and warm lunches every day so you can keep your energy up.

⛳All the rest 

At Picnic you get 30 holidays, we cover your travel expenses and offer a pension plan. We subsidise your Deutschlandticket and with the Lease-a-Bike you can get to work sustainably and healthily. And your phone and laptop are on us, of course.

FAQ 

Do I need a quantitative background? It's a strong advantage, but not a hard requirement. If your internships and projects demonstrate real hands-on ownership and data-driven thinking, we'll consider your application. You do need a Master's degree , basic knowledge of Python or SQL, and relevant work experience.

Does the program include rotations? No, intentionally. We believe depth creates ownership, and ownership creates impact. Rather than rotating across teams, you’ll go deep in one area, build real expertise, and gradually expand your scope as your impact grows. If you have topic preferences, tell us during the process.

In what language should I apply? English. Please include your CV and Master's degree transcript or any other relevant test scores (e.g., GMAT)

What are the long-term opportunities after the program? This program is a fast track into a high-impact career at Picnic, it’s an entry point for a long-term future, not a two-year stopover. 

Career paths here are as varied as the people on them. Some grow vertically, building deep expertise and a team around them as their project expands. Others move laterally - from Commercial to Fulfilment, Distribution to Customer, or wherever their strengths and ambitions take them. What they share is real ownership, real impact, and a career they shaped themselves.

title: Regional Field CTO
location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden)
description:
Black Duck Software, Inc. helps organizations build secure, high-quality software, minimizing risks while maximizing speed and productivity. Black Duck, a recognized pioneer in application security, provides SAST, SCA, and DAST solutions that enable teams to quickly find and fix vulnerabilities and defects in proprietary code, open source components, and application behavior. With a combination of industry-leading tools, services, and expertise, only Black Duck helps organizations maximize security and quality in DevSecOps and throughout the software development life cycle.

Regional Field Chief Technology Officer 

Location: EMEA, Remote (Black Duck has entities in UK, Germany, Netherlands, France, Italy, Ireland, Finland, Sweden) 

Black Duck® meets the board-level risks of modern software with True Scale Application Security, ensuring uncompromised trust in software for the regulated, AI-powered world. Only Black Duck solutions free organizations from tradeoffs between speed, accuracy, and compliance at scale while eliminating security, regulatory, and licensing risks. Whether in the cloud or on premises, Black Duck is the only choice for securing mission-critical software everywhere code happens. With Black Duck, security leaders can make smarter decisions and unleash business innovation with confidence.

We are looking for a Regional Field Chief Technology Officer to serve as a senior technical executive, trusted advisor, and public voice of our technology strategy in the market. In this role, the Regional Field CTO will operate at the intersection of technology, sales, and the customer — engaging directly with C-level and technical leaders at our most strategic customer accounts, translating our AI-driven platform capabilities into credible technical narratives, and representing the company as a thought leader across the industry. This is a customer-facing, pre-sales technical leadership role reporting to the VP of Sales Engineering, with a dotted line to Product & Technology.

Responsibilities :

- Serve as trusted technical advisor and recurring executive sponsor for C-level and senior technical stakeholders at strategic, enterprise, federal and other key accounts — pivoting fluidly between business strategy conversations, risk, compliance, and deep technical architecture reviews.

- Lead highly visible, multidisciplinary technical engagements of strategic importance across the region, including executive briefings, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, customer advisory feedback loops, and partner or analyst-facing discussions.

- Represent Black Duck as a technical evangelist for the platform and roadmap within a region, delivering keynotes, webinars, whitepapers, and thought leadership content at industry events, and representing the company externally with press, analysts, and partners.

- Translate Black Duck platform AI/ML, detection engine, and platform architecture capabilities into clear, credible narratives for both technical and executive audiences, speaking candidly to responsible AI practices such as data privacy, model governance, and human-in-the-loop controls.

- Partner with Sales and Presales leadership on the region’s most strategic and enterprise opportunities, leading technical deep-dives, architecture reviews, whiteboard sessions, and executive briefings, and advising on the technical implications of new product launches, roadmap changes, and competitive positioning.

- Support RFPs and security questionnaires with authoritative technical input, and articulate competitive and technical differentiation, including nuanced comparisons of AI/ML capabilities against alternatives in the market.

- Proactively engage strategic accounts to strengthen technical trust, identify expansion opportunities, mitigate renewal risk, and guide customers toward secure software development and application security maturity.

- Identify and solve problems of strategic or industry scope, using innovative approaches to remove technical barriers, strengthen customer confidence, and improve business outcomes.

- Provide field-informed guidance on emerging AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows, application security trends, and competitive market dynamics that may influence Black Duck strategy or customer adoption.

- Capture, synthesize, and escalate regional customer, partner, and market feedback into actionable input for Product, Engineering, and Sales systematically capturing technical objections and influencing the roadmap, packaging, launch readiness, and go-to-market strategy.

- Coach, enable, and review technical storytelling by sales engineers and account executives, including how to explain AI features accurately without overclaiming.

Qualifications and Experience Required :

- 15+ years in a senior technical leadership role (CTO, Sales Engineering leader, Principal Architect, or equivalent), including several years in a customer-facing or field/pre-sales capacity.

- Proven track record engaging and influencing C-level and senior technical audiences at enterprise organizations, with demonstrated success across complex enterprise sales cycles.

- Domain expertise in application security (SAST, SCA, DAST), enterprise architecture, cloud/SaaS platforms, APIs and integrations, and security best practices.

- Deep, practical understanding of AI/ML concepts as applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, large language models, behavioral analytics, AI-assisted software development, agentic workflows), along with a candid grasp of their limitations and the practical limitations and controls needed for responsible adoption.

- Demonstrated success negotiating with and influencing executive leadership, significant customers, partners, analysts, or vendors to shape technical decisions and business outcomes.

- Ability to exercise wide latitude in determining objectives and approaches for complex, critical assignments with material regional, functional, or market impact.

- Experience shaping standards, methods, practices, or market-facing technical narratives within an industry or discipline.

- Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear stories for both executive and highly technical audiences, including customers, partners, press, analysts, and internal stakeholders.

- Demonstrated industry presence — conference speaking, published thought leadership, active contribution to industry/analyst communities, customer advisory leadership, or comparable external technical influence.

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and executive audiences.

- Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% to customer sites and industry events.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Qualifications: 

- MBA or other advanced degree.

Black Duck is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, age, disability, sexual orientation, veteran or military service status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. title: (Senior) Account Executive SMB | DACH Market (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst. 

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox – ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden , arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück – seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

In dieser Rolle bist du verantwortlich für den gesamten Sales-Zyklus im DACH-Markt. Du bearbeitest warme Inbound-Anfragen und akquirierst gleichzeitig eigenständig neue Leads, vereinbarst und führst Demo-Termine durch und begleitest den gesamten Prozess bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss. Darüber hinaus unterstützt du bei der technischen Implementierung, um sicherzustellen, dass neue Kund:innen erfolgreich starten. 

Who We Want 

2-3 Jahre B2B Sales Experience.
Du hast bereits mehrere Jahre im B2B-Vertrieb gearbeitet und kennst den gesamten Sales-Zyklus von der Akquise bis zum Abschluss aus erster Hand.

Self-Confident.
Du glaubst an deine Fähigkeit, ein Gespräch zu führen und abzuschließen, ohne dabei arrogant zu wirken.

Self-Starter.
Du baust dir deine eigene Pipeline auf, statt auf eingehende Leads zu warten, und nutzt eine ruhige Woche, um noch aktiver zu prospektieren.

Coachable.
Du nimmst direktes Feedback an, ohne defensiv zu werden, und wendest es sichtbar im nächsten Gespräch an.

Resilient.
Du erholst dich schnell von einem verlorenen Deal oder einer schwierigen Woche und hältst deine Aktivität konstant hoch.

Fast Learner.
Du arbeitest dich schnell in ein technisches Produkt ein und kannst es Kund:innen verständlich erklären.

Structured.
Du hältst deine Pipeline sauber und deine CRM-Notizen zuverlässig, ohne dass man dir hinterherlaufen muss.

Strong communicator.
Du sprichst muttersprachliches Deutsch und verfügst über sehr gute Englischkenntnisse.

Who We Don’t Want 

Relies on leads being handed over. 
Du bist darauf angewiesen, dass Leads dir zugeteilt werden, und kannst oder willst nicht selbst aktiv Kund:innen akquirieren.

Gets defensive with feedback. 
Du reagierst bei direktem Feedback defensiv, statt es anzunehmen und dich weiterzuentwickeln.

Weak written communication. 
Du drückst dich schriftlich nicht klar und professionell aus.

In it for the paycheck alone. 
Du jagst nur dem Gehalt hinterher und bringst kein echtes Interesse am Handwerk des Verkaufens mit.

Your Day To Day 

Demos & Product Presentation (ca. 80%)

- Du überzeugst Prospects davon, an einer Produktpräsentation teilzunehmen, und vereinbarst entsprechende Termine

- Du präsentierst die Fähigkeiten von Superchat überzeugend und zeigst Kund:innen, wie das Produkt ihre konkreten Herausforderungen löst

Lead Sourcing & Prospecting (ca. 10%)

- Du generierst eigenständig neue Pipeline, unabhängig von eingehenden Leads, und identifizierst passende Zielkund:innen im DACH-Markt

Closing (ca. 10%)

- Du überzeugst Prospects davon, einen Vertrag zu unterschreiben, und führst den Sales-Zyklus erfolgreich zum Abschluss

Kund:innen: deine wichtigste Ansprechgruppe im täglichen Austausch - von der ersten Ansprache über Demos bis zum Abschluss
Sales Team: für gemeinsames Training, Knowledge-Sharing und den Austausch von Best Practices im Sales-Zyklus
Customer Success Team: für die Übergabe nach erfolgreichem Abschluss und einen reibungslosen Start ins Onboarding

Why People Choose Us

Etwas Flexibilität für Remote Work bieten wir, aber unser Default und unsere Energie liegen im gemeinsamen Office-Alltag

- Wir legen Wert auf Humbleness und Teamgeist - no Ego, offenes Feedback und die Bereitschaft voneinander zu lernen sind uns wichtiger als Titel

Benefits & culture 

- Du hast die Wahl zwischen einer Urban Sports Club/John Reed Mitgliedschaft oder Fahrkarten/Dance-Abo

Uns ist wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem Menschen wirklich gerne Zeit miteinander verbringen - egal ob beim HYROX-Training, Golfen, Beer-Pong-Turnieren, Running Clubs, Warhammer, gemeinsamen Wochenendaktivitäten oder welcher Community auch immer du hier aufbauen möchtest!

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! 🙂

title: Product Owner (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle bei uns Digitalisierung ist kein Buzzword, sondern eine Haltung.

In deiner Rolle als Product Owner (all genders) gestaltest du digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen, die echten Nutzen schaffen – für Anwender:innen, Organisationen und anspruchsvolle Projekte.

Du verantwortest die Produktvision, übersetzt Anforderungen in umsetzbare Lösungen und bringst Fachbereiche, IT, Stakeholder:innen und externe Partner:innen an einen Tisch. Dabei denkst du nicht nur agil oder klassisch – sondern situativ das, was wirklich funktioniert. 

Welche Aufgaben auf dich warten Digitale Lösungen gestalten & weiterentwickeln - Du entwickelst Ideen und Zielbilder für digitale Produkte, Prozesse und Lösungen.
- Du strukturierst und priorisierst Anforderungen und übersetzt sie gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten in umsetzbare Lösungen.
- Du begleitest digitale Lösungen über verschiedene Phasen hinweg – von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung und Weiterentwicklung.
Projekte steuern & Umsetzung begleiten - Du planst und koordinierst IT- und Digitalisierungsprojekte und behältst Ziele, Termine, Qualität und Ressourcen im Blick.
- Du schaffst Transparenz über Fortschritt, Abhängigkeiten und offene Entscheidungen.
- Du sorgst gemeinsam mit den Projektbeteiligten dafür, dass aus Konzepten funktionierende Lösungen werden.
Anforderungs‑ & Stakeholder‑Management - Du nimmst Anforderungen auf, hinterfragst und strukturierst sie und stimmst sie mit den relevanten Beteiligten ab.
- Du moderierst unterschiedliche Interessen und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
- Du begleitest Veränderungen und unterstützt dabei, neue Prozesse und Lösungen erfolgreich in der Organisation zu verankern.
Beraten & Wissen vermitteln - Du unterstützt bei der Bewertung und Auswahl geeigneter digitaler Lösungen und Technologien.
- Du begleitest bei Bedarf Ausschreibungen, Angebotsbewertungen und Beschaffungsprozesse.
- Du bereitest komplexe Themen verständlich auf und unterstützt Anwender durch Workshops, Schulungen und geeignete Materialien.

Was du mitbringst - mehrjährige Erfahrung in digitalen Projekten, IT-Projekten, Produktentwicklung oder vergleichbaren Rollen mit eigener Verantwortung.
- Ein gutes Verständnis für Nutzer, Prozesse und technische Zusammenhänge.
- Die Fähigkeit, Komplexität zu strukturieren und Entscheidungen herbeizuführen.
- Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mindestens C1).
- Hohe Reisebereitschaft (50% Anwesenheit am Standort Würzburg). 

Warum du bei uns richtig bist Bei uns arbeitest du an Themen, die nicht nur visionär klingen, sondern die Bauwelt tatsächlich smarter und zukunftsfähig machen – und das Ganze in Projekten und mit Kund:innen, die garantiert nicht langweilig werden. Dabei bist du von Anfang bis Ende mitten im Geschehen und hast ein Team an deiner Seite , das fachlich top ist, menschlich der Knaller und jeden Partybus das Fürchten lehrt. Wir glauben an Flexibilität statt Stechuhr, an Vertrauen statt Mikromanagement und an stabile Verhältnisse. Deshalb bekommst du bei uns eine unbefristete Festanstellung in einem familienfreundlichen Umfeld mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheidungen. Außerdem warten Team‑Get‑Aways, gemeinsame Events, Hansefit , ein dickes Benefits‑Paket und eine vernünftige Altersvorsorge auf dich. Wir bringen Kompetenz, Verantwortung, Weiterentwicklung und Humor perfekt unter einen Helm bringt..

title: Product Engineer (Backend/AI) @Briink
description:
What we do At Briink , we’re building AI technology for the global sustainability economy. We work with the world’s largest climate organizations, including CDP and PRI, and multinational companies such as Bayer, Siemens, Commerzbank, E.ON, and Heidelberg Materials.

Our technology helps automate how sustainability data is collected, analyzed, verified, and acted on. Through our work with global climate organizations, what you build at Briink will directly impact the sustainability workflows of more than 30,000 companies, investors, and cities worldwide.

We’re a small team working at enormous scale. Your code won’t sit behind an internal tool or an experimental demo — it will help shape how some of the world’s largest organizations understand and act on their environmental impact. Based at Berlin’s AI Campus, with a second office in London, and backed by over €7 million in funding, we want to prove that some of the world’s most powerful technology can also be a powerful force for good.

Application requirement: Intro video
As part of your application, please submit a short intro video (max 2 minutes) answering:
- Who you are and what you have done/built that is relevant for this role.

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
What's it all about? The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity. 

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.

Your impact As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

The role - Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants 
- Translate complex energy-market and grid requirements into reliable software behaviour 
- Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
- Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
- Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production
- Take your services from architecture and implementation through deployment, monitoring and operation 
- Work closely with energy-market specialists to understand the problem and turn it into pragmatic technical solutions 
- Make architectural and technical decisions that balance reliability, scalability, simplicity and delivery speed 
- Mentor other engineers and raise the technical bar across the team 

What we need from you - You are a self-starter who enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment
- You have several years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production backend systems
- You have experience designing and architecting distributed systems
- You have a “you build it, you run it” mindset and are familiar with Linux, Docker and Kubernetes
- You have strong backend experience with Go or another modern programming language (We primarily use Go, but prior Go experience is not required)
- Experience with asynchronous / event-driven systems. Experience with NATS, Kafka, RabbitMQ or MQTT is a plus
- Solid understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases; experience with InfluxDB or Timescale is a plus
- You communicate clearly and confidently in English

What we offer - Competitive hardware including a standing desk, 4K curved screen, and MacBook Pro  
- City center office location including home office option  
- EGYM Wellpass membership support 
- Educational budget for every employee 
- Team events, summer & winter parties
- Real startup culture by having an impact in a small, motivated team   

Sounds good to you? Please submit your complete application including your salary expectations and earliest starting date.  

After submitting an application our team will review this and get back to you within a couple of business days.

title: Senior/Staff Data Analyst, Storefront
description:
ABOUT QUINCE 

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE 

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

As a Data Specialist, you are responsible for the structure, quality, and continuous development of our technical detail database. - Maintain, manage, and further develop the central technical detail database.

- Create, structure, and quality-assure technical details and construction drawings.

- Define and continuously improve drawing and documentation standards.

- Ensure consistency, traceability, and version control within detail libraries.

- Coordinate and integrate requirements from automation processes into detail standards and data structures.

- Analyze recurring quality deviations and translate findings into standardized details, drawing standards, and databases.

- Track the implementation of agreed improvement measures within relevant drawing and documentation standards.

About you 

Must have 

- Completed vocational training or a degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction Technology, Technical Drafting, or a comparable field.

- Experience in the technical planning and detailed design of building constructions.

- Fluent German and English skills, both written and spoken.

- Experience with dynamic blocks, block libraries, and attribute programming in AutoCAD.

- Knowledge of layer, block, and drawing standards, as well as XREF structures.

We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

- We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.

title: Talent Acquisition Partner
description:
What we do 

RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 600+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain. Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t spoil in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world. 

We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters, and growth is still accelerating. The first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific. 

The role 

You own end-to-end recruiting for a designated set of Technology & Product teams (R&D, as we call it internally), operating as a strategic partner to the leaders you support. The job isn't just filling requisitions; it's raising the quality of every hiring decision made across those teams. Your area is clearly defined, but not a boundary: we work as one TA team, so you'll be expected to support colleagues on other areas and pick up wider TA work when priorities shift. 

This is an AI-native role. You're expected to orchestrate AI across the recruiting lifecycle (sourcing, screening, deliverables, quality checks) and build the systems that make that possible. 

It reports to the Head of Talent Acquisition, R&D. The role is ideally based in Finland, Sweden, or the UK, and the remit is global. Prior experience hiring into the US market isn't a requirement, but it's a big plus, as is a flexibility to work across those time zones if needed. 

What you'll do 

- Own the full recruiting cycle for your Technology & Product teams, from role scoping to offer acceptance: delivering personally where it counts and drawing on TA colleagues and our RPO and consultancy partners where that gets a better result. You own the outcome either way, including the quality bar. 

- Build sourcing pipelines so key roles have engaged candidates before the urgency hits, and sell RELEX credibly to senior, passive candidates, closing offers in competitive markets. 

- Coach hiring managers on role definition, interview design, and selection, and how candidates are assessed: on evidence, through a process you keep sharpening. 

- Deliver market intelligence (talent availability, comp benchmarks, funnel metrics) and spot upcoming hiring needs early, so they're in the plan before they become urgent. 

- Design and run AI-native recruiting workflows, piloting new approaches and updating the standard based on evidence. 

- Work in collaboration with our colleagues, in eg. People Business Partner, Compensation, People Operations, and Employer Branding teams, connecting hiring to the wider employee lifecycle. 

- Take named ownership of initiatives that reach beyond your own teams, such as assessment frameworks, interview standards, AI workflows and drive them to global adoption, working through the wider TA team, People Business Partners, Compensation, and People Operations to make them stick. 

What you'll bring to the table 

- Business acumen and stakeholder influence. You understand how engineering and product organisations work and build credibility with their leaders, operating effectively across a global organization. 

- Full-cycle recruiting delivery. You've managed complex, niche, senior hires under time pressure without losing the quality bar, delivering directly, or alongside TA colleagues and delivery partners. 

- Proactive, global sourcing and talent attraction. You market-map and source actively across platforms and geographies instead of waiting for inbound, and you close senior hires against competing offers. 

- Hiring manager coaching and assessment quality. You guide hiring managers through scoping and calibration, and you challenge requirements when the evidence points elsewhere. 

- Data literacy and market insight. You use pipeline and funnel metrics to show hiring health and your own impact, and you present that comfortably to senior stakeholders. 

- AI orchestration and process improvement. You already work AI-first rather than doing recruiting tasks by hand, and you bring structure to ambiguity instead of waiting for someone else to define it. You're equally comfortable stepping outside your own remit when the team needs it, and you've owned work at a broader scope than your own patch. You've designed something, driven it to adoption, and made it work for other people, in collaboration with TA colleagues, People Business Partners, Compensation, and People Operations. 

What we offer in return 

- Ownership of hiring outcomes for some of RELEX's most important Technology & Product teams, with real input into how that hiring gets done. 

- The chance to recruit for a company where AI sits at the core of the product and the way we work, not at the edges. 

- A financially robust company still growing fast, with the scale and stability to back the hiring you'll be driving. 

- Flexibility in how and where you work, and practical benefits that support work, family, wellness, and everyday life. 

- Two paid volunteering days a year to spend on causes you care about. 

You'll need to be fluent in English. 

We're excited to connect with applicants who share our passion to do hard things, trust each other, and build what's next for the product, the planet, and the people.

About Legal 500 

Legal 500 is a global legal market research, data and intelligence business. Our research helps corporate clients make informed decisions about legal representation and gives law firms insight into their market position, performance, and clients.

Beyond research, we’re building a growing data, benchmarking, market-intelligence and subscription service offering. We bring the legal market together through a global programme of events - awards ceremonies, conferences and roundtables that convene leading law firms, in-house teams and their advisers. And through Legal Business, our journalistic title, we deliver independent news, analysis and commentary on the business of law and the strategy, performance and leadership of the world’s leading law firms.

We are a growing, multi-site organisation, with colleagues working across research, data, technology, product, journalism, commercial and events in London, Leeds and Bristol.

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive Maintenance & Facilities Assistant to support the smooth day-to-day running of our London office and conference facilities. This role is ideal for someone hands-on, organised, adaptable, and solutions-focused; someone who takes pride in maintaining high standards and enjoys being the go-to person for resolving maintenance and facilities issues.

You will work closely with the Facilities Manager and Maintenance Supervisor to ensure our buildings, workspaces, and client-facing facilities are maintained to the highest standards. The role involves a combination of planned maintenance, reactive repairs, health & safety responsibilities, and supporting wider operational needs across the business.

This is a varied role where no two days are the same. The successful candidate will be comfortable prioritising multiple requests, responding to urgent issues, and working both independently and collaboratively with contractors and internal stakeholders. 

Key Responsibilities

- Carry out daily inspections of office areas, ensuring all spaces are tidy, functional, and compliant with health & safety standards.

- Respond promptly to maintenance requests and escalate issues where necessary.

- Support with office moves, desk setups, deliveries, and general logistics.

- Coordinate with external contractors and suppliers for maintenance and repair works.

- Conduct basic repairs and minor installations (e.g., replacing bulbs, assembling furniture, adjusting fittings, minor plumbing and maintenance tasks).

- Maintain accurate records of maintenance schedules and building compliance checks.

- Ensure security systems, fire alarms, and emergency equipment are tested and functioning correctly.

- Assist with setting up meeting rooms, conferences, events, and other operational activities.

- Support the wider Centre Services, AV and Operations teams as required.

- Identify maintenance issues proactively and take ownership of resolving them efficiently. 

What We're Looking For

You'll be practical, dependable, and approachable, with a strong work ethic and a genuine willingness to get stuck in. We are looking for someone who enjoys hands-on work, takes ownership of problems, and can adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment. 

Essential

- Previous experience in a facilities, maintenance, building services, or similar hands-on role.

- Working knowledge of building maintenance, including basic plumbing, electrical, carpentry, or general repair work.

- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.

- Ability to prioritise multiple requests and respond effectively to urgent issues.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with a range of teams.

- A flexible and proactive approach to work.

- Reliable, punctual, and willing to take ownership of tasks through to completion.

- Comfortable working in a client-facing, professional environment. 

Desirable

- Experience within a corporate office, hospitality, events, conference venue, or customer-facing environment.

- Health & Safety awareness or related training.

- Experience working alongside contractors and service providers.

- Fire Marshal or First Aid certification. 

Qualifications

Either: 

- Level 2 or above qualification in Facilities Services, Building Maintenance, Multi-Trade Repair, Plumbing, Carpentry & Joinery, Refurbishment Operations, or a related discipline.

Or: 

- Demonstrable hands-on experience in maintenance, facilities, plumbing, building services, or a similar trade-based environment.

We recognise that practical experience can be just as valuable as formal qualifications. 

Working Arrangements

- 5 days per week onsite at our Fleet Street office. 

- Shift pattern operates between 7:00am to 3:00pm or 11:00am to 7:00pm, depending on business requirements. 

- Flexibility is important, and occasional out-of-hours or weekend support may be required to meet operational needs.

title: Lab Operations Manager
description:
About Substrate

Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem: biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment, and the large-scale, high-quality data they need does not exist. We are building the lab that generates it, with quality and provenance built in. We are not a CRO and we are not a cloud lab.

The company was founded by Mostafa ElSayed, co-founder and CEO; Oli Hoy, who leads the lab buildout and operations; Alexey Morgunov, who leads science and intelligence software; and Anna Huyghues-Despointes, who leads partnerships and go-to-market.

The role

You will run the day-to-day operations of our lab in London, and be the person the scientists come to when something is missing, broken, late or lost. The day-one work is what you would expect: consumables and stock, goods in and cold chain, equipment servicing and calibration, suppliers and purchasing, waste streams and safety records.

Three parts go beyond a standard lab operations job. The first is provenance. Every experiment we sell carries a record of what went into it, down to the lot of the consumable used and the conditions material was held in. If a lot number is not captured, the data point is worth less, and that record runs through you.

The second is that the systems are not written yet. Inventory, goods in, asset registers and ordering exist in no form that will survive the next year. You define what the lab has to capture and work with the science and software teams to make sure it does. 

The third is that sample handling and stock control here get automated, and you help specify the system that does it. Every sample, plate, reagent and consumable lot carries a barcode, scanned at each point it is handled, so the record is created by the work rather than reconstructed afterwards. The same scan draws stock down, which turns reordering from a weekly count into something the system flags before anyone is short. Our software team is building that layer now and the requirements have to come from the lab floor: what gets a barcode, where the scan points sit, and what happens when a label will not read. Some find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing which one you are.

Your first 90 days

First 30 days

- Take ownership of goods in: every delivery received, booked in, stored correctly and recorded.

- Map how material moves through the lab and build the first accurate picture of what we hold. That map is the input to a fully barcoded scheme and system.

Days 30 to 60

- Put a working inventory and reorder system in place, with minimum levels set from real consumption rather than guesses, and own the purchasing loop.

- Agree the barcode and labelling scheme with the software team, and get equipment records in one place.

Days 60 to 90

- Run the lab as a routine that does not depend on being asked, with the barcoded system live across one workflow, goods-in to bench to stock draw-down, feeding our provenance record.

Who you are

You have run the physical side of a lab where being out of stock stops the work: biotech, pharma, a university or institute lab, or a manufacturing or diagnostics operation built around one. Lab consumables and the rhythm of a working lab are already familiar to you, you have handled real volume and real inventory, and you know the difference between a system that works on paper and one that works at eight on a Monday morning. We are not asking for a particular speciality, but you should arrive able to run the lab rather than learn what one needs.

Must have:

- Two or more years running a lab or comparable physical operation, hands-on and accountable for the result.

- Practical stock control: goods in, inventory records, reorder points, stock counts that reconcile.

- Buying from suppliers: raising orders, comparing quotes, managing lead times.

- Hands-on with a barcoded or scanned stock system, including what goes wrong when people skip the scan.

- Lab environment experience: cold storage, hazardous waste, containment, controlled materials.

Nice to have:

- Health and safety training such as IOSH.

- Developed or co-developed a barcode system for autonomous workflows in labs, including working with software development teams to implement it.

How we work and who you will work with

This role is on site five days a week at 20 Triton Street in London, because the lab is a physical place and the work is in it. The wider founding team is distributed across London, New York and Europe. You will report to Simon Varzandeh, a member of our scientific staff working on protein characterisation and one of the lab's heaviest users, and work alongside the protein science and functional genomics teams, the engineers building the tracking and stock system with you, and operations on facilities, health and safety and purchasing. You will be the first person here whose whole job is focused on the lab floor.

We work in the open and each person owns their area. UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover.

Our process and how to apply

Four stages: a short screening call; a conversation about how you work, before anything technical; a practical exercise from our lab setup, sent separately, then a discussion of what you did and why; then references. 

We are sharing this role through our network first. Send a note and your CV to ----- and if you are not sure whether you are a fit, send it anyway. 

Substrate is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions on merit, scope-fit, and the strength of the working relationship we expect to build with each hire. Applications welcome from candidates of any background.

The Team

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. - Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

- Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

description:
About 9fin 

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity 

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic 

- Trusted advisor to your leaders : You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

- Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

- Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve : You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

- Fully embedded in your team : You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

- Catching things early : You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

- Org design : You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

- Talent management : You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

- Learning & development : You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

- Reward : You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

- Performance : You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

- Hands up for the bigger stuff : You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical 

- Employee Relations (ER) : Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

- Embedding people products : Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

- Data : Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

- Wellbeing support : 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

- Cultural ambassador : Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You 

This role will be a great fit if you:

- Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

title: Senior Software Engineer — Real-Time Ad Serving
description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to www.zetaglobal.com .

THE ROLE 

As a Senior Software Engineer on the LiveIntent Real-Time Ad Serving team, you will design, develop, and own the business logic that powers programmatic advertising at scale — ad selection, targeting, frequency capping, budget pacing, and delivery optimization.

The real-time platform is built on C++ and Lua: C++ provides the high-performance server framework, while Lua implements the business logic layer. You will work primarily in Lua, developing and evolving the features that directly serve LiveIntent's product — ensuring advertisers get the best outcomes and publishers maximize their revenue. While we're open to candidates with experience in any backend language, a willingness to work with Lua is essential — we provide time and the right environment to get up to speed.

You will collaborate closely with Product, working on features that directly impact LiveIntent's customers — from ad targeting and delivery to reporting and optimization. This is a hands-on engineering role where your code runs in production handling billions of daily transactions.

This is a hybrid/remote role based out of our Berlin, Germany or Prague, Czech Republic offices.

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES 

- Develop and optimize business logic in Lua for ad selection, targeting, frequency capping, and budget pacing

- Design, build, and maintain real-time services processing 200K+ requests per second with strict latency requirements

- Work closely with Product to deliver features that meet advertiser and publisher needs

- Ensure code quality through code reviews, automated testing, and continuous integration

- Participate in architecture discussions and influence the technical roadmap

- Participate in on-call rotation to support production systems

DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS 

- 5+ years of software engineering experience in backend development

- Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, performance optimization

- Experience building and operating distributed systems in production

- Exposure to the full software development lifecycle — from design to production and monitoring

- Strong commitment to code quality, automated testing, and documentation

- Proficient English (the interview process will be held in English)

- Experience with Lua or willingness to learn (we provide time and the right environment)

- Experience in online advertising / ad tech (RTB, programmatic, DSP/SSP) is a plus

- Proficiency in a systems-level language (C++, Go, Rust, or Java) is a plus

- Experience with MongoDB and real-time data processing is a plus

- Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) at scale is a plus

- Experience with AI-assisted development tools and agentic workflows is a plus

- Experience with OpenRTB protocol and ad exchange integrations is a plus

BENEFITS & PERKS 

- Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA 

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression. 

We’re committed to building a workplace culture of trust and belonging, so everyone feels invited to bring their whole selves to work. We provide a forum for employees to celebrate, support and advocate for one another. title: Engineering Director
description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

- Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets

- Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS

- Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About the Role 

This role will be based at our London HQ, following a 3-day hybrid schedule. You will bring together two engineering organisations into one unified team, run our largest engineering hub outside of Sydney, and serve as the primary engineering partner for our UK commercial and product leaders. Reporting to the CTO in Sydney, you will work closely with executives in London and operate with the clarity and self-direction that distance requires.

- Unify two orgs into one. The team is 35 engineers across two engineering organisations, growing towards 50. You will manage six to eight direct reports (all engineering managers) and establish a unified standard for how both teams plan, build, ship, and hold each other accountable.

- Run the London engineering site. Serve as the senior engineering voice in the building, including dotted-line support for US-focused teams based in London. That means setting the tone, facilitating local leadership forums, and making London a place where exceptional engineers join and stay.

- Translate commercial outcomes. Partner directly with UK commercial, clinical, and product leaders as a true peer. You will serve as the primary contact across the business, evaluating trade-offs through a commercial lens and communicating them rather than escalating them.

- Shape what we build, not just how. Evaluate whether proposed initiatives deliver real value and instil that thoughtful product instinct across your management team.

- Build and mentor the team. Own senior hiring in London, set clear quality standards, and mentor engineering managers to become skilled hiring partners who can recruit effectively.

- Raise engineering standards. Strengthen delivery predictability, quality, and operational reliability across a distributed organisation spanning Sydney, London, and the US.

About You 

- You’ve managed an engineering organisation of 30+ people through managers, with at least five years of experience developing other managers.

- You have experience guiding an organisation through significant structural change such as an integration, restructure, or operational overhaul where teams emerged stronger. You can reflect openly on the parts that went badly and what you learned.

- You use AI tooling in your own work, and you've changed how a team builds with it rather than just your own workflow. You can say what it made better, what it made worse, and where you chose not to use it.

- You’ve demonstrated commercial fluency, holding constructive conversations on revenue, margin, and prioritisation while making speed, scope, and risk trade-offs clear and explicit.

- You have experience building and scaling systems from the ground up, rather than simply maintaining a machine that already runs itself.

- You are technically strong and partner credibly with senior engineers, you evaluate system architecture, and spot when technical estimates lack substance. Coding is not the job, but you are comfortable getting on the tools to prototype an idea or unblock your team, and you can govern an ecosystem built on React, React Native, TypeScript, Go microservices, GraphQL, Kubernetes, and GCP.

- You are comfortable managing a site distant from headquarters across various time zones. You leverage asynchronous communication, operating with high agency, independence, and clarity.

Nice to Have 

- Experience in regulated sectors (such as healthtech, fintech or gaming), finding creative paths forward inside compliance constraints rather than being stopped by them.

- Experience navigating post-acquisition organisational integration and the messy alignment work that follows.

Why join Eucalyptus

- What's next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer, launching into new conditions, demographics and geographies.

- Build something world-changing - We're on the path to becoming the world's largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced and deeply rewarding.

- Make real impact - Your work directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.

- Accelerate your growth - High ownership, continuous feedback and dedicated development support.

- Join a motivated team - Talented peers solving complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What's ahead in the UK

- Be an owner - Your own stake in the business with our employee options programme

- Invest in your growth - Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave

- Work flexibly - Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration

- Support your well-being - Private health insurance through Vitality, or a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you

- Take time off - 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks a year

- Join a connected team - A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport and seasonal events

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Après investigation, ton but est d'apporter une réponse ou solution à ton interlocuteur, ou quand cela est nécessaire, d'escalader le problème aux équipes techniques. Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la Pennylane Academy et tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

4 à 6 mois :

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu 

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Notre data policy 

🇬🇧 Personal Data 

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more 

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten 

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team.

Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners.

Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe.

In just six years, we have managed to:

You will act as a trusted legal partner for teams across Pennylane, managing a broad range of commercial and operational agreements from drafting through to signature and post-signature follow-up.

- Draft and negotiate purchase orders and related agreements with partner firms, primarily outside France, with a current focus on Germany.

- Manage contracts with strategic international suppliers.

- Maintain and improve templates in line with regulatory, product and business developments.

- Work with Sales and Partnerships to streamline the contracting process.

Customer, reseller and integrator agreements 

- Improve customer terms and conditions for SME customers across France and Europe.

- Support Sales with the contracting process and automated quotations.

- Review and negotiate agreements with Pennylane integrators and resellers.

- Anticipate the contractual impact of key regulations, including e-invoicing, payment services and the EU AI Act.

- Contribute to contract templates and playbooks.

Legal operations and collaboration 

- Structure and improve internal contracting processes to increase efficiency and scalability.

- Optimize our contract management tools, including Tomorro, Pivot and Notion.

- Identify opportunities to automate repetitive, low-value tasks, including through AI.

- Provide clear, pragmatic advice to Sales, Partnerships, Finance, Security and Product teams.

- Train non-legal teams and help build a strong legal culture across Pennylane.

- You are a qualified lawyer or legal counsel with extensive experience in contract law, gained in a law firm, particularly in IP/IT, technology or SaaS, and/or in a fast-growing tech company.

- You are fluent in English and have a working knowledge of Franch and German.

- You have strong expertise in B2B SaaS agreements , including IP, indemnification, liability caps, SLAs and data-related provisions.

- You are autonomous and comfortable managing matters from start to finish.

- You have experience working in a multi-jurisdictional environment, particularly across France and Europe.

- You are interested in legal operations and technology, and have experience structuring processes or optimizing contract management tools.

- You are a genuine business partner , able to help teams move quickly while protecting the company.

- You are rigorous, concise and able to make complex legal topics clear to non-legal audiences.

- You enjoy building in a fast-moving environment where ambiguity, prioritization and rapid iteration are part of the job.

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu as aussi la charge d'aider les comptables d’entreprises et de cabinets à intégrer leurs données sur Pennylane afin de faciliter leur migration.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ? 

3 premiers mois :

- Tu intègres la Pennylane Academy et tu te formes sur le produit et les rouages de l'équipe.

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu gagnes en autonomie et prends intégralement les commandes en assurant un bon suivi des demandes jusqu’à la résolution complète des tickets pour garantir la satisfaction des utilisateurs.

- Tu commences à gérer des demandes clients de plus en plus complexe.

- Tu contribues à la création et à l’actualisation des supports d’aide à disposition du client afin de développer leur autonomie.

- Tu partages à tes collègues tes connaissances comptables et ton expérience "terrain".

- Tu portes la voix comme l’usage du client et tu partages aux équipes produit des retours construits.

Et ensuite... :

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Dans le futur, tu auras des possibilités d'évoluer vers la résolution de questions plus pointues dans l'équipe Support mais aussi vers d'autres équipes telles que les gestionnaires de comptes ou les responsables de la mise en œuvre pour nos clients.

Compétences requises 

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)
